headline: US probes Iran link to up to 50 hacked cargo ships
pages: The US government has intelligence that up to 50 commercial shipping vessels were recently compromised by cyberattacks, and officials are investigating possible links to Iran, NPR reports. A US official, a former military cyber operator and an industry executive described the breaches, which The Wall Street Journal first reported. NPR has previously reported that experts believe Iranian hackers were behind attacks on US water systems in August and on refrigeration systems that spoiled food at military base grocery stores. The Coast Guard and FBI sent a specialized team in August to board two foreign vessels bound for US ports.
Both agencies said there are no current reports of operational disruptions, danger to crews or environmental harm. The attacks come during the ongoing war between the US and Iran. Source: NPR.
